name: gh_pulls_list
description: List pull requests in a repository with state/base/head filters (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

state.description: Either open, closed, or all to filter by state. Default: open.

head.description: Filter pulls by head branch name, e.g. fix/webhook-retry-backoff.

base.description: Filter pulls by base branch name. Example: main.

limit.description: The number of results per page (max 100). GitHub param: per_page. Default: 30.
